look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson one
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 1, lesson T01, What is cryptocurrency; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: A price on a phone
scenes.desc: A phone shows a fictional BTC price ticking; the question: what is this?

scenes.name: What money is
scenes.desc: Cash turns into a bank balance: money is value people agree to accept, and most of it is already digital.

scenes.name: Digital assets
scenes.desc: Definition of a digital asset, with examples that are and are not crypto.

scenes.name: A shared record
scenes.desc: Cryptocurrency defined: a payment is written to a public ledger copied across many computers, with no bank in the middle.

scenes.name: Meet Bitcoin
scenes.desc: Bitcoin, symbol BTC: the first cryptocurrency, launched in 2009, with a maximum of 21 million coins.

scenes.name: No coin in your phone
scenes.desc: The misconception: a wallet holds keys, not coins; the coins are entries on the ledger.

scenes.name: Coins and tokens
scenes.desc: Coins run their own blockchain; tokens like USDT are built on top of existing ones.

scenes.name: Your balance
scenes.desc: A fictional 0.002 BTC balance; its value is amount times price: 120 USDT.

scenes.name: When price moves
scenes.desc: The price moves up and down; the BTC amount stays the same while its value changes.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and calculate: 0.002 BTC at 65,000 USDT; the answer 130 USDT is revealed.

scenes.name: Crypto or not
scenes.desc: Five items are sorted into crypto and not crypto.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: No government guarantee, volatile prices, lost keys and scams; owning coins is not the same as a futures contract.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T02, why do crypto prices move.
